# Levelrail

> Open source, self-hosted deployment platform and lightweight Coolify alternative. Push to git and get a running app with HTTPS, logs, traces, metrics, previews and one-click rollback on your own Linux servers. Single Go binary, Docker runtime, built-in observability, scale to zero. Apache 2.0.

## Start here

- [Docs](https://docs.levelrail.com): hosted documentation
- [Getting started](https://docs.levelrail.com/getting-started): install and first deploy
- [Feature status](https://docs.levelrail.com/feature-status): what is stable and what is beta
- [Comparison](https://docs.levelrail.com/comparison): Levelrail against Coolify, Dokploy, CapRover, Dokku and Kamal
